leave_request_modal: Form values (start_date, end_date, reason) persist after 6 seconds wait
Leave type dropdown persists selected value

day_request_modal: Form values (date, reason) persist after 6 seconds wait
Request type dropdown persists selected value

Date inputs maintained values during extended wait
fix_verification: useCallback hooks correctly implemented for modal callbacks (closeLeaveModal, closeDayRequestModal, closeSwapModal, closeMessagesModal)
getJobTitleDisplay and formatDate memoized with useCallback
Modal components wrapped with React.memo in StaffProfileModals.js

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for modal form reset issue has been verified and is working correctly. The root cause was parent component re-renders invalidating React.memo optimization because callback functions were being recreated on each render. Fix: useCallback hooks for all modal callbacks (closeLeaveModal, closeDayRequestModal, closeSwapModal, closeMessagesModal) and memoizing fetchAllData, getJobTitleDisplay, formatDate. All modal forms now persist values correctly even after 10+ seconds of waiting.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Parent component (StaffProfile) re-renders were causing callback functions (onClose, onSuccess) to be recreated. This invalidated React.memo optimization on modal components, causing child modals to re-render and reset their internal form state.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Wrapped all modal callback functions in useCallback hooks with appropriate dependency arrays. This ensures stable prop references are passed to memoized modal components, preventing unnecessary re-renders.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All form fields (text input, date pickers, dropdowns) in Leave Request and Day Request modals now persist values correctly after 5+ seconds and even during extended 10+ second interactions.
